notes.title: [Announcement] A Notification Regarding the Delay of Full Release
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Project Moon.

Regrettably, we were forced to delay the official release of Library Of Ruina by a few months.

The release is being postponed in order to comply with the process for releasing the game on the console market.


As planned, additional Battle Symbols and achievements will be added on May 28th.

The voice acting for rewritten dialogue in the final chapter of the game is planned to be applied in early June.


Our postponement of the full release will not affect the upcoming update or the volume of the game itself; the contents of the release version will remain the same as what we had planned. 

The only difference is in the form of the release.


We'd like to let you know that the production of merchandise such as the artbook and rewards for Tumblebug supporters is also proceeding without any hitches in the schedule.


The official release of the game on Steam and consoles is slated to take place on August 5th (KST; GMT+9).



We are terribly sorry to have gone back on the schedule we had announced.

notes.title: May 29th. Major changes Plan
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Project Moon.

We'd like to notify you of the major changes that will be arriving with the upcoming update on May 29th.

[b]1. Combat Pages bound to Key Pages[/b]

	- Each Key page now comes with a preset bookshelf (deck) of Combat pages.

	- Level up the Key page to unlock the ability to customize its Combat bookshelf.

	- We're implementing this change to reduce the difficulty of deck building in the early game.

	- Focusing on RPG elements, good equipment (Key pages) will now come with good skills (Combat pages) immediately with this change. New players will only have to think about what Key page to use in the early game, and will gradually be introduced to new cards and archetypes as they grow and unlock the ability to customize their decks.

	- The aim of this change is to lift the burden of building the right deck of Combat pages while the player is being introduced to other mechanics.


[b]
2. Appearance Projection[/b]

	- When a Key page reaches a certain level, you will be able to change its appearance without having to equip a different Key page.

	- The appearance of a Key page will be automatically registered to the upcoming Appearance Projection inventory once it reaches the level where the feature is unlocked.


[b]3. Abnormality Battles[/b]

	- Upon completing the Assignments of a floor, the player must fight Abnormalities before they can open the next floor.

	- The Abnormalities lie dormant in books where the ideal environment for them is simulated. 

	- Librarians will enter one of the books and fight the librarian who has been corrupted by the Abnormality's world.

	- Upon winning the battle, a librarian will be freed, and you will be able to use the Abnormality's cards during receptions.


[b]4. Abnormality Pages[/b]

	- Abnormality pages can only be used by librarians now.

	

[b]5. Emotion System
[/b]
	- The whole team will share their Emotion Level, rather than individual units having their own separate Emotion Levels.
